name: Review Sentiment
description: Reads product reviews and says whether each is positive, negative or neutral. Runs on 0G Compute's TeeML model (0gm-1.0-35b-a3b).

task.instructions: Classify the sentiment of each product review as positive, negative or neutral. Neutral means it states facts without liking or disliking the product.

labels.name: positive
labels.hint: love, great, excellent, perfect, happy, recommend

labels.name: negative
labels.hint: terrible, broke, awful, waste, disappointed, refund

labels.name: neutral
labels.hint: arrived, comes in, weighs, measures, contains, delivered
